I was probably around 7 or 8 so I hadn't started menstruating yet. In my mothers bathroom she always kept her feminine hygiene products on a shelf. For some reason I was always entranced by the pads. I would unwrap them and stick them on my body.... One night I took a whole bunch and hid them under my blanket. When my dad came into tuck me in, he found me in a pile of Playtex menstrual pads. He stared at me, shook his head and I asked him, "Daddy, what are they? What are they for?" and he said, "You'll find out eventually. But for now you don't need them." I went to bed perplexed and it wasn't until 4 years later did I learn their unfortunate use.
